description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Dikdeniya, Kobeygane D/S Division, Kurunegala District - (2414400013)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determination of land ownership for specific parcels of land in Kurunegala District. It involves declarations under the Registration of Title Act regarding title settlements for multiple land parcels, including details of owners, extent, nature, and class of land. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it primarily concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
